name: Ōgawara (Japan)
description: A orange field charged at the centre with the Ōgawara town emblem in white: a broken ring with a stylised letter M and a pointed stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Ōgawara, a town in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 2 September 1972.

features.role: Ōgawara town emblem — a broken ring with a stylised letter M and a pointed stroke
